verdicts.reason: A: clean left-aligned stack (brand, 2-line headline, subline, pills, CTA) with a clear hierarchy and shared left edge. Flaws: the headline overlaps the peach circle (intentional-looking), the CTA sits below the pills and is a bit detached, the right circle is a floating dead decoration, and the bottom is empty. B: the headline runs almost edge to edge with nearly no right margin, and its left edge is misaligned with SOLSTICE and the subline. The subline sits on the circle edge, so the text is split across two backgrounds. The CTA is right-shifted and unaligned, and the pills are pushed below it, so the reading order is jumbled. The decorative circle at the top right is arbitrary.
